name: chimera
description: A universal file inspector: open a file, see how it's put together, and pull it apart.
author: Gabriel Mariani

scripts.fuzz: rolldown fuzz/fuzz.ts fuzz/repro.ts --dir fuzz/build --platform node --format esm --log-level warn && node fuzz/build/fuzz.js
scripts.fuzz:repro: rolldown fuzz/fuzz.ts fuzz/repro.ts --dir fuzz/build --platform node --format esm --log-level warn && node fuzz/build/repro.js
